item.title: Evangelical leader resigns canon title over controversial same-sex blessings
item.description: Attempts to reconsider the use of the controversial prayers were rebuffed.

item.title: Worship leader Ron Kenoly dies at 81
item.description: Ron Kenoly, a pioneering Christian worship leader whose anthems helped shape modern praise music and whose ministry emphasized worship as service rather than performance, has died. He was 81.

item.title: Is New Zealand experiencing its own 'Quiet Revival'?
item.description: The so-called “Quiet Revival” report by the Bible Society noting an upsurge in Christianity among young people in the U.K. is also seen to an extent among young New Zealanders, according to a report by Baptists.

item.title: Scots families send clear signal to government over home education
item.description: Proposals could disproportionately impact children with special needs or disabilities.

item.title: Darlington nurse describes brave stand for biological reality in US speech
item.description: The NHS has been "ideologically captured" by transgenderism, nurse Bethany Hutchison said at an event on Capitol Hill in Washington DC.

item.title: West has 'repeatedly failed Assyrian Christians'
item.description: A religious freedom activist warns that the Assyrian Christian community in the Middle East "does not have a chance of survival”.

item.title: 2,000-year-old 'Pilgrim's Path' opens in Jerusalem
item.description: An ancient road that may have been built in the days of Jesus and led up to the Jerusalem Temple Mount has been opened to the public for the first time.

item.title: Christian group welcomes British sanctions on Iranians
item.description: Britain stopped shot of designating the Revolutionary Guard a terrorist organisation.

item.title: Pastor, daughter and son-in-law slain in Plateau state, Nigeria
item.description: Fulani herdsmen last month killed a pastor, his daughter and her husband, leaving the couple’s 3-month-old baby with a machete wound, in Plateau state, Nigeria.

item.title: Prince and Princess of Wales visit Lambeth Palace to meet new Archbishop of Canterbury
item.description: The Prince and Princess of Wales have paid an official visit to Lambeth Palace.
